resolvedQuestions.question: Importer choice (API vs HTML) — what each preserves vs drops
resolvedQuestions.verdict: API import primary for database-heavy spaces; HTML fallback only when no token. Importer auto-converts databases->Bases, formulas->Bases formulas, rollups->Bases formulas, relations->wikilinks, downloads attachments. Drops comments, secondary views, gallery covers.

resolvedQuestions.question: mcp-notion read surface mapping (24 tools + 5 API gaps)
resolvedQuestions.verdict: 24 MCP tools (pages/blocks/data-sources/comments/users/search) + 5 API gaps (file_uploads/views/property-items/async-tasks/daily-notes) mapped to a 7-step inventory procedure. Limits: 25-ref truncation, title-only search, data_source_id keying, ~3 req/s.

resolvedQuestions.question: mcp-obsidian write surface mapping
resolvedQuestions.verdict: Three surfaces: notesmd-cli (headless primary), cyanheads MCP (app-backed optional), plugin file-layer (.base/_database.md/data.json). No CLI/MCP tool authors .base/Dataview — pure file-layer. Unattended migration is headless-capable.

resolvedQuestions.question: Relations & rollups recovery path
resolvedQuestions.verdict: Importer auto-converts rollups->Bases formulas (14 functions) and relations->wikilinks. Dual relations need Notion Bases plugin two-way Relation or Dataview back-ref. Bases v1.9.7 added cross-note lookups (no aggregation/auto-refresh). Notion Bases plugin provides native relation/lookup/rollup columns + subtasks.

resolvedQuestions.question: Formulas 2.0 recovery
resolvedQuestions.verdict: Importer convertNotionFormulaToObsidian() with hybrid (live) / static (fallback) strategy. Logical/text/math/date/list mostly convert; style()/name()/email() have no equivalent; dateBetween/dateRange VERIFY. DataviewJS for complex read-only; Notion Bases plugin formulas for new interactive.

resolvedQuestions.question: Files, attachments & comments carry-over
resolvedQuestions.verdict: Attachments carried (downloaded + ![]() embeds; downloadExternalAttachments opt-in; incremental dedup). Comments confirmed gap — recovery: MCP comment-list -> appended ## Comments section + comment_count frontmatter. Page cover -> frontmatter cover; gallery covers gap.

resolvedQuestions.question: Multi-view databases & nested hierarchy
resolvedQuestions.verdict: Only default table view imports. Core Bases covers 4/10 view types; Notion Bases plugin 7/10; form/map/dashboard no parity (lost). Nested hierarchy preserved (page->folder, synced blocks->files). View reconstruction is file-layer only.

resolvedQuestions.question: Required vs optional plugins
resolvedQuestions.verdict: Required: Core Bases, Notion Bases community plugin (relational/view parity), Dataview (already in mcp-obsidian knowledge). Optional: Tasks, Kanban, Calendar/Full Calendar, Charts, Bases Toolbox, Excalidraw, Git, Outliner, BRAT. No parity: Form/Map/Dashboard, Database buttons.

resolvedQuestions.question: mcp-notion-reads / mcp-obsidian-writes division of labor
resolvedQuestions.verdict: 7-step method: inventory (mcp-notion reads) -> human Importer bulk (Mode A) -> headless reconstruction (mcp-obsidian file-layer: relations/rollups/formulas/comments/views) -> verify. Mode B = agent gap-closing. Agent never drives Importer UI; complements at file layer. Entire reconstruction+verification headless-capable.

resolvedQuestions.question: Parity & verification (no silent loss)
resolvedQuestions.verdict: 11 programmatic parity checks (mcp-notion source vs mcp-obsidian/grep target): counts, schema, relation resolution, rollup/formula render, attachments, comments, views, hierarchy, links, types. Auto-preserved-vs-reconstruct matrix produced. Final method decision ready for phase 002+.
